question:
The value of the expression

( {1 + (1)/(3)} )( {1 + (1)/(4)} )( {1 + (1)/(5)} )...( {1 + (1)/({n - 1)}} ) is:
solution:
**Given:**

( 1 + (1)/(3) )( 1 + (1)/(4) )( 1 + (1)/(5) )...( 1 + (1)/({n - 1)} )

**Formula used:**

Simplify each term:

 1 + (1)/(k) = (k+1)/(k) 

Thus, the expression becomes:

 (4)/(3) times (5)/(4) times (6)/(5) times ... times (n)/(n-1) 

**Calculations:**

The terms will cancel out sequentially:

⇒ (n)/(3) 

**∴ The value of the expression is ( {(n)/(3)} ).**
